text: Hello everyone, welcome to the English class.Please prepare your textbook, workbook, notebook and your stationery for the class.Today we are going to learn Module 4 Unit 3, Fire, Period 4, Rules for Fire Safety.First, let's enjoy a rhyme.Look at the fire.Fire, fire, fire.Call the fire station.1-1-9Bring the fire engine.Engine, engine, engine.The brave firefighters put out the fire.Last lesson, a firefighter, Mr.Xu, came to Rainbow Primary School and talked about fire safety to the students.What did he say?Can you say it by yourself?Let's say it together.Fires can start in forests, in schools and at home.People must be careful.And he showed a poster about fire safety.Do you remember these signs?1Don't smoke.Can you spell the word smoke?S-M-O-K-E, smoke.2Don't play near fires.3Don't start campfires.Spell campfires, please.C-A-M-P-F-I-R-E-S, campfires.4Don't play with matches.Can you spell matches?M-A-T-C-H-E-S, matches.Let's read them together.The students know some signs for fire safety.Now, Ms.Fang is asking them a question about it.Please listen.Children, can you tell me about fire safety?Let's read it together.Can you answer Ms.Fang's question?Think about it.What do the students answer?Let's watch the flash.What do the students say?This sign comes to Alice's mind.What does she say?We mustn't play with matches.She says,We mustn't play with matches.We've learned the word must.And this is must not.Can you read this word?That's right.Mustn't.Follow me.And read the sentence after Alice.And this sign comes to Danny's mind.What does he say?People mustn't smoke.He says,People mustn't smoke.Please listen and follow.Say it by yourself.How about Kitty?What will she say?Please think about it.Children mustn't play near fires.She says,Children mustn't play near fires.Because this sign is especially for children.These are the students' answers.Let's read the dialogue with the flash.Please read the whole dialogue by yourself.Nice reading.Please take out your workbook.Turn to page 85.Let's do part E.Think and complete.Here is a poster about fire safety.Can you use must or must not to complete it?Let's check.Children must not play near fires.Please read the dialogue with the flash.We must not start campfires.Three.People must smoke in the smoking room.Four.We must not play with matches.Five.We must be careful both in the forest and at home.Are your answers correct?Well done.For fire safety, what mustn't we do?Let's do ask and answer.I am S1 and you are S2.Can you answer my question?Number one.Number two.Number three and four.Can you ask and answer by yourself?Good job.Different places, different fire safety rules.Please open your workbook again.Let's do part D.Think, match and say.Can you think and match the rules with the proper places?Write down the letters A, B, C or D in the boxes.In the forest, don't smoke.At home, don't smoke.At school, don't smoke.Good.Now, can you talk about fire safety in the forest, at home and at school?Please listen to Danny.At school, we mustn't smoke.Excellent.Here are more fire safety signs and rules.At the gas station, no smoking, no burning, no engine, no mobile phones.In the shopping mall, no smoking.Do not lock.Do not obstruct.Do not use a lift in case of fire.In the factory, no smoking, no burning.Do not extinguish with water.No flammable materials.Please always remember fire safety rules.If we meet a fire, what must or mustn't we do?Here is a rhyme about it.Please watch.When you see a fire, quickly go outside, but never use the lift.It is dangerous inside.If it is all smoky, cover your mouth and nose, and crawl out very fast.Never stop for toys or clothes.Now you are outside.You know what to do.Listen to the firefighters.Here they are to help you.When you see a fire, go outside quickly.Is that right?Yes, that's right.Go outside quickly.We can also say You must go outside quickly.You must go outside quickly.Read these sentences by yourself.Look, there is a lift.When you see a fire, can you use the lift?No, it's dangerous inside.Don't use the lift.We can also say You mustn't use the lift.Say it with me together.You mustn't use the lift.Now can you use You must or mustn't to talk about this part?If it is all smoky, what must or mustn't you do?Cover your mouth and nose.Yes, crawl.Crawl out very fast.When you see a fire, can you stop for toys or clothes?No, don't stop for toys or clothes.Say it together.Don't stop for toys or clothes.Can you use You must or mustn't to talk about this part?Let's try to say the rhyme with the flash.Can you talk about it with You must or mustn't?Have a try.Lastly, can talk about it.Please listen to her.When you see a fire, you must go outside quickly.If it is all smoky, cover your mouth and nose.You must crawl out very fast.You mustn't stop for toys or clothes.You must listen to the firefighters.Excellent, and you can do it well too.Today we know some fire safety rules.Please keep these rules in your mind, and they will make you safe.Here are the assignments.Read this part of Look and Say on page 57 of your textbook.Do the exercise on page 86 of your workbook, part G, Look, Match and Write.Talk about fire safety in forests, at home and at school.So much for the class.Goodbye.
